test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Shyam said that he would go into surgery the following day.

options.text: Shyam said, “I will go into surgery tomorrow.”
Shyam said, “He will go into surgery tomorrow.”
Shyam said, “He would go into surgery tomorrow.”
Shyam said, “I will go into surgery the day after tomorrow.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Shyam said, “I will go into surgery tomorrow.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it to Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• Here, **'said'** will not change because the reporting verb does not have any object.
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be removed.
 
• Commas and inverted commas will be added.
 
• The pronoun 'he' will be changed into 'I' because we know that the first-person pronouns are changed according to the subject of the reporting verb.
 
• 'would' will be changed into 'will'. (Indirect to Direct Transformation)
 
• The adverb **'the following day​'** will be changed into** 'tomorrow​'.**
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Shyam said, “I will go into surgery tomorrow.”*
